readerCopy.body: Winning an old fight can consume the energy required for the less familiar move that would change the larger pattern. When Mars opposes the North Node, practiced conflict and forward movement face each other directly, making the battle already understood feel more urgent than the action that leads somewhere new. The old problem may still require attention. Competence at surviving it becomes costly when every available resource keeps flowing back into the same setup.
